ns2:section.sectionText: The Oceans, 3 hours. Explores the Oceans and science in general. The workings of the earths interior and the resulting ocean features, the influence of the oceans on earths climate, and the ecology of marine organisms are studied. The class emphasizes how scientific advances are made by paradigm shifts. Students make observations and form hypotheses in a process that might be called the scientific method but which is a general problem-solving approach for everyone. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
